To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
TomoSAR is feasible from high-resolution spaceborne SAR data and that it can be applied to urban areas and to man-made infrastructure.
TomoSAR from TerraSAR-X and Cosmo-Skymed is a very powerful and promising technique for 3-D and even 4-D imaging of urban areas and other man-made structures.
TomoSAR is a very powerful tool for the 3-D imaging of man-made objects and their dynamics, which is demonstrated by the reconstruction of an entire building with a very high level of details.

the following aspects: 1) the potential of spaceborne SARs for 3-D/4-D reconstruction, 2) regularization and model selection, 3) 3-D and velocity estimation, 4) reconstruction of an entire building from spaceborne SARs, and 5) 4-D reconstruction of an entire city from spaceborne SAR.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
TomoSAR is a promising tool for 3-D and even 4-D imaging of man-made infrastructure from space.
the new spaceborne SARs are well suited to 3-D and even 4-D imaging of urban environments and man-made infrastructure, and they offer a great improvement compared with the former spaceborne systems.
the combination of the new spaceborne SARs with the new TomoSAR algorithms and the proposed model selection and estimation schemes leads to a very powerful 3-D and space-time imaging technique.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the new class of spaceborne SAR sensors is very promising for urban TomoSAR.
the new spaceborne SAR systems offer a new and unique possibility for the detailed 4-D imaging of urban areas, which has not been achieved by any other remote sensing sensor.
the new class of spaceborne SARs enables us to perform 3-D and even 4-D recon-struction of entire buildings and their dynamics in a single resolution cell with unprecedented quality.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the new class of spaceborne SARs allows to reconstruct urban areas with a resolution of a few meters and a height resolution of about 1 m.
the new class of SARs offers the opportunity to reconstruct urban areas and manmade infrastructure with meter resolution and centimeter accuracy.

the new generation of high-resolution spaceborne SARs is capable of imaging buildings and other man-made objects with unprecedented resolution, which is of interest to the scientific community, as well as to the civil protection and emergency management community.
